newsitem.title: USA: Houston group raises stake in PremiumWear.
newsitem.headline: Houston group raises stake in PremiumWear.

text.p: A group led by Francisco Lorenzo, chairman of Savoy Partners Inc, a private investment banking company in Houston, said Wednesday it raised its stake in PremiumWear Inc to 140,600 common shares or 6.83 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include net purchases of 30,500 common shares bought from May 23 to September 12 at prices ranging from $7.042 to $10.50 per share.
PremiumWear was previously known as Munsingwear Inc The company changed its name and stock symbol on September 12 as part of an agreement with Supreme International Corp.
